comment: Recorded by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeDisplayBrightnessHidVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_HID_VECTORS set to this directory. ioctl and buffers are WindowsRazerDisplayBrightnessHidTransport.SubmitInputIoctl and CreateControlBuffer (lowercase hex) for each defined usage. A sequence row composes DisplayBrightnessHidController over a transport that returns the row's writes in order (Applied once they run out), creates the runtime with the device provider available when verified is true and observes once, or leaves it unobserved and unavailable otherwise, then runs each request and records its status (ControlOperationStatus as a number) and message, and every usage the transport was asked for.
